neighbours.label: the second ' as' in an as...as comparison (as much as you can, as widely as possible), as opposed to other uses of ' as'
fire: Our trainer told us to walk as often as we could.
Try to keep the two samples as alike as possible.
The notice was spread as broadly as the budget allowed.
Doctors advise staying as active as you can after surgery.
Please describe the fault as clearly as possible.
The hotel served as much food as we could eat.
Sleep as long as you need before the drive.
The buyers wanted the deal closed as quickly as possible.
quiet: Our trainer worked as a nurse before she came here.
Try to use the two samples as a control group.

The hotel served fruit such as figs and plums.
